title: session-lock: renew()/release()/same-holder-reacquire carry the unguarded path-vs-inode residue
description: FOLLOW-UP from the TASK-090 review (LOW-4, out of that ticket's AC scope, confirmed untouched at close). renew() (unconditional tmp+rename), release() (read-then-unlink), and the same-holder re-acquire branch carry the SAME path-vs-inode residue TASK-090 closed on the steal/reclaim paths: a holder descheduled after its read whose lock goes stale and is stolen will clobber (renew) or delete (release) the stealer's fresh record on wake — unguarded and currently unmentioned in comments. Remedy per the TASK-090 honesty standard: either extend the content-checked guard (compare against the record the holder last wrote/observed before the mutating op; fail closed on mismatch) or land AC2-style accepted-residue comments with an accurate hazard description per path. Guard preferred where near-free (release read-then-unlink is the natural candidate — it already reads); document-only acceptable where the guard is disproportionate (renew's tmp+rename may be). The reviewer's residual-window enumeration (window #7) is the authoritative hazard description — see the TASK-090 close comment.
acceptance_criteria: release(): content-checked delete (read-verify-unlink against the holder's expected record) or an accurate accepted-residue comment; decision justified in the hand-off; regression spec if guarded (tests-first per tdd).
renew(): same treatment (guard or honest comment), same justification standard.
Same-holder re-acquire branch (acquire :391 area): same treatment.
All existing session-lock specs (30) stay green; comments in touched paths meet the TASK-090 honesty standard (detection-not-prevention, no overclaims).
